Maya: Quick postmortem follow-up: cloud auth had brief 5xxs at 04:10 UTC which caused model-registry write retries to spike and a small bump in user-facing errors. We should assign owners for IG fixes + weekly recurrence checks.
Jon: I can take the client side changes: add jittered refresh, cap concurrent refreshes, and a per-request retry cap. ETA: PR by Thu.
Priya: I'll own registry protections: batch writes, add a write circuit-breaker and a read-only fallback for 10m on consecutive failures. ETA: next Tue.
Maya: Ops: please add an alert for registry write success < 96% over 5m and attach the runbook.
infra-bot: Created tickets: [AUTH-700] "Client jitter + caps" -> Jon (due 2026-04-02). https://jira.redwood/AUTH-700
infra-bot: Created tickets: [REG-610] "Registry batching + read-only fallback" -> Priya (due 2026-04-06). https://jira.redwood/REG-610
Jon: Will add a small CI smoke to simulate provider 5xx and post the command here.
Priya: I'll draft the runbook snippet and performance notes for fallback variance.
Maya: Action summary for JIRA: Jon -> AUTH-700 by Thu; Priya -> REG-610 by Tue; Ops -> alert + runbook link by tomorrow AM. Scheduling a 15m pulse meeting Mon to watch for recurrence.
Jon: :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Note: AUTH-700 status -> in-progress (updated by Jon)
